visual_clone_mission.goal: Make the local /about route closely match the reference About page on 1440px desktop and 390px mobile with no unresolved P0 or P1 deviations.
visual_clone_mission.global_objective: Reconstruct the reference layout and responsive behavior without changing other local routes.

hard_rules.rule: Use Browser/CDP and screenshots for visual verification.
Do not create a second Header, Footer, ContactBand or FAQ implementation.
Keep visual overrides isolated to the About route.
Fix all P0 and P1 desktop and mobile deviations before reporting ready.

visual_clone_mission.goal_activation_tail: Continue the build, browser screenshot, compare, and fix loop until the report has desktop and mobile evidence, no unresolved P0/P1 deviations, or a concrete blocker is documented.
